sessionName: Week 16 - Sales process and proposals revisited
summary: George Berrington revisited the sales process with Paul and Rebecca twelve weeks on. CFOs pushed back on gain-share as the only recommended option because of savings baseline disputes. We changed the recommended fee to a fixed fee with a performance bonus, and replaced the no-discount rule with a 5% early-signing discount.

discussion.keyPoints: Three of five proposals since week 4 stalled on how the savings baseline would be calculated. Two CFOs said their auditors would not accept a 25% share without a cap.
Paul held the no-discount line but lost one deal to a competitor offering 8% off. Rebecca suggested a small, time-limited incentive instead.
Written CFO sponsorship has been used on four deals and helped each time.

recommendations.recommendation: Recommend a fixed fee plus a performance bonus of 10% of verified savings above target, capped at £50k. This replaces the earlier single gain-share option at 25% of first-year savings.
Offer a 5% discount for signing within 14 days of proposal. This replaces the earlier no-discounting rule.
Confirm CFO sponsorship in writing before any scoping work starts.
Prepare a one-page answer to the 'we already have a procurement team' objection.

actions.action: Update the proposal template to the fixed fee plus bonus model

nextFocus: Check conversion on the new fee model over the next six proposals.
nextPreparation: Rebecca to track proposal outcomes and signing times under the new terms.
